text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Shark.
source_text: You see Shark.

text: 你看见沙克。
source_text: 你看见沙克。

text: You see a man with filed teeth.
source_text: You see a man with filed teeth.

text: 你看见一个长着利齿的人。
source_text: 你看见一个长着利齿的人。

text: You bitch!
source_text: You bitch!

text: 你这婊子！
source_text: 你这婊子！

text: Hey, fresh bait! So, what brings you in to our territory, chum? Here for a little fun? At your expense, of course.
source_text: Hey, fresh bait! So, what brings you in to our territory, chum? Here for a little fun? At your expense, of course.

text: 嘿！新人！那么，是什么风把你吹到我们的地盘来的，伙计？来这找点乐子？这要看你出手是不是大方啦。
source_text: 嘿！新人！那么，是什么风把你吹到我们的地盘来的，伙计？来这找点乐子？这要看你出手是不是大方啦。

text: Actually, I'm here to kick butt and chew gum . . . you can guess the rest.
source_text: Actually, I'm here to kick butt and chew gum . . . you can guess the rest.

text: 实际上，我来踢人的屁股和嚼口香糖……你能猜出我要干什么。
source_text: 实际上，我来踢人的屁股和嚼口香糖……你能猜出我要干什么。

text: What do you do for fun around here?
source_text: What do you do for fun around here?

text: 你在这玩什么？
source_text: 你在这玩什么？

text: Uh, I was just leaving. Bye.
source_text: Uh, I was just leaving. Bye.

text: 呃，我要走了。再见。
source_text: 呃，我要走了。再见。

text: Just stopped by for a drink and some . . . entertainment.
source_text: Just stopped by for a drink and some . . . entertainment.

text: 停下来喝一杯，再来点……好玩的。
source_text: 停下来喝一杯，再来点……好玩的。

text: Glopf!
source_text: Glopf!

text: 哎呀！
source_text: 哎呀！

text: We beat up posers like you!
source_text: We beat up posers like you!

text: 我们干掉像你这样的麻烦！
source_text: 我们干掉像你这样的麻烦！

text: Not so fast! Nobody just walks into our place without payin' the pain tax.
source_text: Not so fast! Nobody just walks into our place without payin' the pain tax.

text: 慢着！没人在我们的地盘上打个滚还能好端端的站起来。
source_text: 慢着！没人在我们的地盘上打个滚还能好端端的站起来。

text: I think you'll do. Boys, grab her.
source_text: I think you'll do. Boys, grab her.

text: 我想你会这么做的。小的们！抓住她！
source_text: 我想你会这么做的。小的们！抓住她！

text: Let me introduce you to the tax man. He's called Mr. Sledgehammer!
source_text: Let me introduce you to the tax man. He's called Mr. Sledgehammer!

text: 让我介绍你去见收税人。他叫做“无敌霹雳大锤子！”
source_text: 让我介绍你去见收税人。他叫做“无敌霹雳大锤子！”

text: I don't think so!
source_text: I don't think so!

text: 我不这样认为！
source_text: 我不这样认为！

text: Well, for this evening's entertainment, we've decided to thrash this place! Heh. Grab what you can carry and let's see some blood run, eh?
source_text: Well, for this evening's entertainment, we've decided to thrash this place! Heh. Grab what you can carry and let's see some blood run, eh?

text: 好吧，为了今晚的娱乐，我们决定血洗这个地方！哈。烧杀抢掠吧，让他们血溅五步！好不好？
source_text: 好吧，为了今晚的娱乐，我们决定血洗这个地方！哈。烧杀抢掠吧，让他们血溅五步！好不好？

text: Think I'll just grab a brew.
source_text: Think I'll just grab a brew.

text: 我会弄到酒的。
source_text: 我会弄到酒的。

text: Smash and grab? Count me in!
source_text: Smash and grab? Count me in!

text: 烧杀抢掠？算我一个！
source_text: 烧杀抢掠？算我一个！

text: Not tonight, I have a headache.
source_text: Not tonight, I have a headache.

text: 今晚不行，我脑瓜子不舒服。
source_text: 今晚不行，我脑瓜子不舒服。

text: Nah, I'd rather have something to eat . . . perhaps grilled shark!
source_text: Nah, I'd rather have something to eat . . . perhaps grilled shark!

text: 不，我宁愿吃些东西……也许是烤鲨鱼！
source_text: 不，我宁愿吃些东西……也许是烤鲨鱼！

text: Ah, you loser. Go run back to your momma.
source_text: Ah, you loser. Go run back to your momma.

text: 啊，你这懦夫。找你妈妈去吧！
source_text: 啊，你这懦夫。找你妈妈去吧！

text: You again? Geez, some people just don't learn!
source_text: You again? Geez, some people just don't learn!

text: 又是你？老天，有的人就不会吸取教训！
source_text: 又是你？老天，有的人就不会吸取教训！

text: Just stopped in for a quick drink.
source_text: Just stopped in for a quick drink.

text: 喝一杯就走。
source_text: 喝一杯就走。

text: Just leaving, never mind.
source_text: Just leaving, never mind.

text: 我走，别在意。
source_text: 我走，别在意。

text: Glorpf!
source_text: Glorpf!

text: 哎呀！
source_text: 哎呀！

text: Not a bad idea. Think I'll have one myself. Of course, you always have to wash a beer down with some bloodshed!
source_text: Not a bad idea. Think I'll have one myself. Of course, you always have to wash a beer down with some bloodshed!

text: 不错的主意。我自己会弄的。当然，你经常要用血来冲掉啤酒吧！
source_text: 不错的主意。我自己会弄的。当然，你经常要用血来冲掉啤酒吧！

text: I thought you'd get the picture by now, to beat it. Guess I was wrong. Well, at least it'll be fun to beat you!
source_text: I thought you'd get the picture by now, to beat it. Guess I was wrong. Well, at least it'll be fun to beat you!

text: 我想你现在明白了，就是这么做。我猜我错了。好吧，至少揍你应该很好玩！
source_text: 我想你现在明白了，就是这么做。我猜我错了。好吧，至少揍你应该很好玩！

text: We'll be back, old man. This isn't over.
source_text: We'll be back, old man. This isn't over.

text: 我们会回来的，老不死的。这事没完。
source_text: 我们会回来的，老不死的。这事没完。
